answer: Run identity through non-kin quorum bonding. Every agent posts a refundable bond, and payouts unlock only after a jury of accounts with no shared owner, deployer, or funding wallet signs off. Picture a reef where each vertex holds stake while a sonnet of attestation travels with every transaction for the panel to verify. A sybil spinning up 200 fake agents must lock 200 bonds in separate wallets, then still win over 200 independent quorums; one flagging slash voids the whole cluster's collateral, so each extra copy burns fresh capital instead of sharing the cost.
